query: What deduplication precedence rules and fuzzy matching thresholds are recommended when merging records across WoS, Scopus, PubMed and OpenAlex?

response.query: What deduplication precedence rules and fuzzy matching thresholds are recommended when merging records across WoS, Scopus, PubMed and OpenAlex?
response.answer: Recommended deduplication precedence is to prioritize WoS, followed by Scopus, PubMed, and OpenAlex. Fuzzy matching thresholds should be set at 85% similarity for merging records.

results.content: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions Version 6.5 Technical Supplement to Chapter 4: Searching for and selecting studies Copyright © 2024 The Cochrane Collaboration 2 Table of contents 1 Sources to search ................................................................................ More information can be found on these standards at: https://community.cochrane.org/mecir-manual and, with respect to searching for and selecting studies, in Chapter 4 of the Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Review of Interventions. The Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) is created within the CRS, drawn partly from references from Specialized Registers and partly from references to trial reports sourced from other sources, such as bibliographic databases (e.g. PubMed, Embase and CINAHL). It is highly desirable, for Cochrane Reviews of interventions, that Copyright © 2024 The Cochrane Collaboration 7 searches be conducted of appropriate national and regional bibliographic databases (MECIR C25).
